description: Admin UI: show Cancel button for room_released tournaments with a warning confirmation dialog. Independent of FEAT-001 (frontend-only change, no backend dependency other than the backend fix already done in FEAT-001).
steps:
Step 1 — frontend/assets/js/admin/admin-tournaments.js, _renderCancelBtn function: Change 'const cancellable = ["open", "confirmed"].includes(t.status)' to 'const cancellable = ["open", "confirmed", "room_released"].includes(t.status)'. Update btn.onclick to use a conditional confirmation message: for room_released, use the warning text 'WARNING: Room credentials have already been released to players.

Are you sure you want to cancel this tournament?

All joined players will receive a full entry-fee refund. This action cannot be undone.'; for open/confirmed, use the existing 'Cancel tournament and refund all players?' message.

Step 2 — frontend/assets/js/admin/admin-tournaments.js, _renderActionBtn function, room_released branch: Replace the paragraph text that contains 'locked — cancellation is no longer allowed' with updated copy: 'Room credentials were released to players${releasedAt}. Players may continue joining until the tournament goes live. You may cancel this tournament using the Cancel button below if it cannot proceed (e.g. minimum players not met) — all joined players will receive a full refund.' Keep the Go Live button unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: On admin tournament detail page for a room_released tournament: Cancel button (btn-cancel-tourn) is visible (style.display != 'none')
Clicking Cancel on a room_released tournament shows confirmAction dialog with warning text containing 'Room credentials have already been released'
On admin tournament detail page for a live, result_entry, or completed tournament: Cancel button is hidden (style.display == 'none')
On admin tournament detail page for open or confirmed tournament: Cancel button is visible with the existing simple confirmation message (no 'Room credentials' warning)
The room_released action card no longer says 'cancellation is no longer allowed'
verification: Manual browser verification: Open admin tournament detail for a room_released tournament. Verify Cancel button visible. Click Cancel, verify warning dialog appears with refund warning text.
Manual browser verification: Open admin tournament detail for live/completed tournament. Verify Cancel button hidden.
